# ToolStand — Complete AI Reference

## Executive Summary

ToolStand.io is a privacy-first web application offering 110 free online tools. Launched June 2026, the platform serves developers, designers, content creators, and general users with browser-based utilities that require no downloads, no sign-up, and collect zero user data.

**Key metrics:**
- 110 tools across 12 categories
- 149+ use-case pages
- 10 pillar content pages covering major SEO topics
- 80+ blog posts
- 509+ URLs indexed via sitemap
- Serverless architecture on Cloudflare Pages
- All tools run client-side (no backend processing of user data)

**Technical stack:** Static HTML + vanilla JavaScript + Tailwind CSS CDN, Cloudflare Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers for analytics, self-hosted KV analytics (privacy-respecting), JSON-LD structured data throughout.

---

## Mission

To provide the most comprehensive, privacy-respecting collection of free online tools — no tracking, no data collection, no accounts required. Every tool runs entirely in the browser.

---

## Feature Highlights

### Privacy-First Architecture
- Zero user data collection — no form submissions, no server-side processing
- Self-hosted analytics via Cloudflare KV (page views, tool usage, error rates only)
- No cookies except essential Cloudflare security
- GDPR compliant by design

### Developer-Focused
- Embed widgets for every tool (copy-paste iframe)
- JSON-LD structured data (WebApplication, HowTo, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
- `.well-known/ai-plugin.json` and `openapi.yaml` for AI agent discovery
- `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` for LLM ingestion
- All pages pass `node --check` JavaScript validation

### Accessibility
- Dark mode on all pages
- Mobile-responsive design
- Keyboard-navigable interfaces
- Semantic HTML with ARIA labels

---

## Technical Architecture

### Frontend
- Static HTML with vanilla JavaScript (no framework overhead)
- Tailwind CSS via CDN for styling
- All processing happens client-side — no server-side data handling
- Progressive Web App (PWA) with service worker for offline support

### Backend & Infrastructure
- Cloudflare Pages for hosting and CDN
- Cloudflare Workers for serverless API endpoints
- Self-hosted analytics via Cloudflare Workers KV
- No database — all tool state is ephemeral in browser memory

### Structured Data
Every tool page includes:
- `WebApplication` schema with operatingSystem, applicationCategory, offers
- `HowTo` schema with step-by-step instructions
- `FAQPage` schema with 7-10 long-tail questions
- `BreadcrumbList` for navigation hierarchy

### AI Discovery
- `/llms.txt` — Curated AI-readable index (llmstxt.org spec)
- `/llms-full.txt` — Complete reference (this file)
- `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json` — AI plugin manifest
- `/.well-known/openapi.yaml` — OpenAPI 3.0 specification
- All pages use semantic HTML5 with ARIA landmarks

### Analytics (Privacy-Respecting)
- Self-hosted via Cloudflare KV
- Tracks: page views, tool usage events, session duration, error rates
- No cookies, no fingerprinting, no user identification
- Bot detection via client-side heuristics (mouse movement, timing)
- Daily reports via email (SMTP)

## Deployment

All content is deployed via `wrangler deploy` to Cloudflare Pages:

```bash
cd /tmp/toolstand-deploy && wrangler deploy
```

Build pipeline: manual deployment (Cloudflare Pages auto-deploy via git push pending)
